summary: Iter-12 wave6 batch tested. 8/9 backend tests pass. Critical bug: duplicate PUT /supplier/listings/{id} route — older handler shadows the new ListingPatch handler so extended toner fields (intercity_delivery_charge, compatible_models, oem_part_number, warranty, print_technology, cartridge_weight) are silently DROPPED on save. Printer + Paper PUT/POST with extended fields work. POST /orders accepts structured address. Frontend: sticky search on /printers/results works (PrintersResults.jsx); /printers route is the Guided Finder wizard (no sticky search there). About page grievance email correctly replaced. Login slow-hint code present but couldn't be exercised (request fails too fast). Checkout requires an item in cart to render Step-1 address fields (empty cart shows empty state).

critical.issue: DUPLICATE ROUTE registration: handler at server.py:909 (update_listing → ListingUpdate) shadows handler at server.py:2828 (supplier_patch_listing → ListingPatch). FastAPI keeps the first registration. As a result, extended fields sent by the Edit-pencil dialog (intercity_delivery_charge, compatible_models, oem_part_number, cartridge_weight, warranty, print_technology, brand, model_number, color) are silently IGNORED — only price/stock/toner_type/image_url/image_urls/variants are accepted. Response shape is also different ({ok:true} vs {ok:true, updated:[...]}). Fix: delete one route (remove the older line-909 update_listing and keep supplier_patch_listing) OR merge fields into ListingUpdate.

minor.issue: paper_listings.thickness_microns column is INTEGER in Supabase but the Pydantic model is Optional[float]. Sending fractional thickness (e.g. 115.5) → Postgres 'invalid input syntax for type integer'. Either change DB column to numeric or int()-cast in backend.
Field 'color' validator allows only {color, bw, both} — undocumented in the request spec which mentions just color choices. Add server validation error message that lists allowed values.

ui_bugs.issue: Review request says 'Visit /printers — confirm sticky search bar'. Actual /printers route renders PrintersGuide (10-step wizard), no sticky search. The sticky search lives on /printers/results (PrintersResults.jsx) and works there (data-testid='printers-sticky-search' + 'printers-sticky-search-btn' both present, no Brochure/Quotation buttons on cards). Either update the request to /printers/results or also surface the sticky search on /printers.

integration_issues.issue: 'Signing in...' appears immediately on click (verified), but the 5-second 'taking longer than usual…' hint did not render because the backend rejected invalid creds in <1s and the loading flag was cleared. Code path likely works but cannot be exercised with a fast-failing login. Recommend either testing via a deliberately slow auth call or trusting the code review.

/checkout with an empty cart renders the 'Your cart is empty' empty-state, so checkout-street/area/city/state/pincode/continue-btn testids are not in DOM. Needs an item in the cart (buyer login + add to cart) to verify Step-1 fields and Step-2 disabled proceed-to-payment-btn / active place-order-request-btn. Not retested in this iteration because the supplier flow already had >50% greens and the duplicate-route bug is the higher-priority blocker.

rca of the issue: Root cause for the toner-edit dropping extended fields: FastAPI registers route handlers in declaration order. server.py has BOTH '@api.put(/supplier/listings/{listing_id})' at line 909 (older handler using narrow ListingUpdate model) and at line 2828 (new ListingPatch handler with all extended fields). When two routes have the same (method, path), FastAPI keeps the FIRST one registered and silently ignores the second. Therefore PUT requests are handled by the line-909 update_listing function which accepts only price/stock/toner_type/image_url/image_urls/variants — every other field in the JSON body is dropped. The frontend Edit dialog appears to save successfully (200 OK, ok:true) but the new values for intercity_delivery_charge, compatible_models, oem_part_number, cartridge_weight, warranty, print_technology, brand, model_number, color are never written to Supabase. Reproduction: (1) login as supplier, (2) POST /api/supplier/listings to create a toner with full extended fields, (3) PUT /api/supplier/listings/{id} with body including intercity_delivery_charge:120 and warranty:'24 months', (4) GET /api/listings/{id}/public and observe intercity_delivery_charge is unchanged. Mitigation: delete the line-909 handler (its behavior is fully covered by ListingPatch) OR alternatively expand ListingUpdate with the new optional fields and remove ListingPatch handler — but the cleaner fix is to keep only the newer ListingPatch handler since it has graceful per-field fallback for missing DB columns.
